test_suite.title: Verify successful registration with valid email and password
steps: Navigate to the registration page
Enter a valid unique email address (e.g., user@example.com)
Enter a valid password meeting all requirements (e.g., Password1!)
Click the Register button
test_suite.expected_result: Registration succeeds, a confirmation email is sent to the provided address, and the account is created in an inactive state

test_suite.title: Verify account remains inactive until email is confirmed
steps: Complete registration with valid credentials
Attempt to log in immediately without confirming the email
Check the confirmation email and click the confirmation link
Attempt to log in again after confirming the email
test_suite.expected_result: Login attempt before confirmation fails with an account-inactive message; login attempt after confirmation succeeds and user is redirected to the dashboard

test_suite.title: Verify registration fails with a duplicate email address
steps: Navigate to the registration page
Enter an email address already associated with an existing account
Enter a valid password (e.g., Password1!)
Click the Register button
test_suite.expected_result: Registration fails and an error message is displayed indicating the email address is already in use

test_suite.title: Verify registration fails with an invalid email format
steps: Navigate to the registration page
Enter an improperly formatted email address (e.g., userexample.com, user@, @example.com)
Enter a valid password (e.g., Password1!)
Click the Register button
test_suite.expected_result: Registration fails and a validation error message is displayed indicating the email format is invalid

test_suite.title: Verify registration fails when password does not meet complexity requirements
steps: Navigate to the registration page
Enter a valid unique email address

Attempt registration with each of the following weak passwords: 'password' (no uppercase/number/special), 'Password1' (no special character), 'Pass1!' (less than 8 characters), 'PASSWORD1!' (no lowercase)
Click the Register button after each attempt
test_suite.expected_result: Each registration attempt fails with a descriptive validation error indicating which password requirement was not met

test_suite.title: Verify registration with edge case password of exactly 8 characters meeting all requirements
steps: Navigate to the registration page
Enter a valid unique email address
Enter a password that is exactly 8 characters and satisfies all rules (e.g., Pass1!ab)
Click the Register button
test_suite.expected_result: Registration succeeds, confirming that the minimum boundary of 8 characters is accepted

test_suite.title: Verify registration form is not vulnerable to SQL injection via email field
steps: Navigate to the registration page
Enter a SQL injection payload in the email field (e.g., ' OR '1'='1'; --)
Enter a valid password (e.g., Password1!)
Click the Register button
test_suite.expected_result: Registration fails gracefully with an invalid email format error; no database error is exposed and the application remains stable

test_suite.title: Verify system performance under concurrent registration requests
steps: Prepare 100 unique valid user registration payloads
Simulate 100 concurrent registration requests using a load testing tool (e.g., JMeter or k6)
Monitor server response times, error rates, and confirmation email dispatch
Record results and compare against defined SLA thresholds
test_suite.expected_result: All 100 registrations complete successfully with response times under 2 seconds, no errors occur, and all confirmation emails are dispatched without significant delay
